newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Swedish March jobless seen 8.4 pct-poll.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Swedish March jobless seen 8.4 pct-poll.

text.p: Sweden's official unemployment rate is expected to have fallen to 8.4 percent in March from 8.8 percent in February, a Reuters poll of 12 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts ranged from 8.1 percent to 8.6 percent. In March 1996, unemployment was 7.4 percent.
For the full year 1997, nine analysts expected unemployment of 7.9 percent on average with forecasts ranging from 7.3 percent to 8.3 percent.
According to Sweden's labour market board (Ams) -- which publishes weekly figures -- March unemployment was 8.0 percent, down from 8.4 percent in February.
Sweden will release its figures at 1100 GMT on April 11.
